//: The one place the web app is configured. Docker rewrites ApiBaseUrl at container start (see docker/20-api-base-url.sh); the mobile app's equivalent is App.Mobile/Resources/Raw/appsettings.json.
//GoogleClientId: The Google OAuth 'Web application' client id (…apps.googleusercontent.com). Empty hides the Sign in with Google button. Not a secret. Docker and Render overwrite it from GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID at container start; the API needs the same value in Google__ClientIds__0.
//Platform: Web, or Mobile to preview the phone shell in a desktop browser's device emulation. Mobile also switches non-Admin users to the Mobile column of the access matrix, so leave it on Web for anything but a UI review. Prefer MobilePreviewOrigins below: it needs no edit and cannot be committed by accident.
//MobilePreviewOrigins: Origins that render the phone shell regardless of Platform, so one build can serve the web shell and the phone shell at the same time from two ports. `dotnet run --project FrontEnd/App.Web --launch-profile mobile` serves :7002; :7001 stays the web shell. Local development only - a deployed origin must never appear here, because Mobile also switches every non-Admin user to the Mobile column of the access matrix.
